items.title: Lead Software Engineer
items.description: Leading full-stack and AI engineering at Aidalet. Built a Next.js + PostgreSQL learning platform with performance analytics and learning paths, a Flask/Pinecone RAG service indexing 90K+ vectors to power exam-prep question generation (80%+ expert approval), and a FastAPI + SvelteKit payroll-document sorter powered by Mistral AI and OCR that collapses a multi-hour manual task into a ~2-minute wait.

items.title: Founding Full-Stack Developer
items.description: Founding engineer at Bakchich, Tunisia's leading crowdfunding platform for content creators (50K+ MAU). Led the payment workflow powering thousands of monthly card and DCB transactions with an 80% load-time improvement, helped migrate the PHP monolith to an Nx monorepo of Next.js apps on Kubernetes/Argo CD, and extended the real-time stream-alerts service with RabbitMQ, Socket.IO, and Redis.

items.title: Data Scientist
items.description: End-of-studies internship on identity verification and fraud detection. Trained CNNs in TensorFlow to classify Tunisia's four national ID documents, fine-tuned OCR to extract personal information from cursive handwriting, and shipped a Java mobile app with the UX/UI team enabling employees to run KYC checks from a document photo in seconds.

items.title: Data Analysis Intern
items.description: Started with working on multiple bots scraping public data organizing it into sheets for the marketing team and then moved onto creating a dashboard using Google Analytics data of their E-commerce website.

items.title: Frontend / Full-stack Developer
items.description: Participated in Marketing & outreach events raising awareness about the available opportunities and the exciting experiences possible through AIESEC. Developed a Landing page for AIESEC Medina and internal tool to optimize the processes and workflow of the IGX and OGX teams.

items.title: Producer
items.description: My first experience in light art, and I haven't stopped since. Member of the production team taking care of every technical aspect behind the great artworks displayed as well as inventory management. Working alongside artists from all around the globe where communication is key to turning their vision into reality.
